title: 5b-4: semantic anchors per component
description:
## Parent

sutra/44 (5b PRD: component discovery + vocabulary)

## What to build

Identify 3-7 semantic anchors (load-bearing symbols) per component. Rank symbols within a component by: in-degree (callers within component), betweenness centrality, git stability (inverse churn from git log), naming alignment with component name. Store top N in `semantic_anchors` table (ephemeral, recomputed alongside membership). Include anchors in `sutra_components` output as \"start here\" pointers.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Symbols within a component ranked by combined score (in-degree, centrality, stability, naming)
- [ ] Top 3-7 anchors selected per component (adaptive based on component size)
- [ ] Anchors stored in semantic_anchors table, recomputed on clustering recompute
- [ ] sutra_components output includes anchors per component
- [ ] Git stability factor uses churn data from git log (low churn = high stability)

## Blocked by

- sutra/45 (5b-1: basic component discovery)

decisions: Use pagerank as centrality proxy instead of betweenness centrality — already computed, O(1) lookup vs O(V*E)
Store qualified_name in symbol_name column for durability across reindexes
Rank-based normalization with average-rank ties to prevent tied signals from introducing noise
